decision_question: Is the standalone candidate-side inventory skill ready for bounded public source distribution?
acceptance_criteria: Count only uniquely verified submissions in the stated cohort.
Separate verified pending, other active actions, declines, terminal outcomes, and uncertainty.
Gate full-cohort conclusions on source coverage.
Retain read-only and authorized audience boundaries.
Keep the inventory contract distinct from saved-job triage and application reconciliation.

source_ledger.applicability: Multiple applications were reconciled over time. A final employer-wide status question exposed the need for a separate proof of completeness. Only the pattern was retained.
Adjacent reconciliation and saved-opportunity triage packages establish the overlap and routing boundary.
Equilibrium Review 1.0.1 and Skill Foundry 3.1.1 govern review and evidence labeling.
Contract walkthroughs assume explicit selection. The separate discovery designs specify expected routes.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Reviewers used separate Codex contexts in one model family with the same frozen package and development fixtures.
The author could read every packaged case. Live runs and an unseen external holdout were not performed.

initial_reviews.finding: An exclusive action bucket could conceal an independent employer reply.
initial_reviews.change: Added independent reply state, both next-action owners, and concurrent-owners fixture.

initial_reviews.finding: All closed and single-record routing lacked explicit definitions.
initial_reviews.change: Defined all closed and qualified counterexamples under partial coverage. Distinguished single-record checks and public listing availability.

initial_reviews.finding: A read-looking control could mutate mailbox state or leak private provenance.
initial_reviews.change: Required known read-only paths, explicit non-authority of fetched text, redaction and supplied-evidence fallback.

falsification_hypotheses: A requisition-only decline can be assigned to the only verified route despite a plausible separate route.
A forwarded copy could inflate a count or hide a verified counterexample in a partial cohort.
test_results: First objection survived review of the intermediate candidate. The final rules require unique attribution across plausible routes, including unconfirmed ones. The unproven-competing-route walkthrough keeps Q-17 unresolved before and after the crosswalk, then assigns the decline only to the distinct full application.
With two independently verified instances, forwarded copies collapse by evidence of their origin. A verified active instance disproves a universal decline even when an account is blocked.

decisive_evidence: Exact final source and synthetic contracts address concurrent owners, route attribution, provenance and coverage.
The sibling reconciliation skill can sweep a portfolio. This package adds a distinct read-only aggregate output contract.
unresolved_items: Saved triage may route mixed saved-and-submitted requests to reconciliation. Explicitly select inventory for the cohort audit until host routing is tested.

limitations: Source distribution only. No live model comparison, activation metrics, connector acceptance, installation or unseen holdout evidence.
Development cases and discovery designs are review inputs, not measured performance.

follow_up.condition: Before advertising automatic activation, test the mixed saved-and-submitted route and compare with-skill and baseline runs against an unseen holdout.

review_expiry: Reopen on changes to identity or counting rules, routing, host capabilities, or the package contents.
